Fixes bug Bff1731a132: Agents waiting for a lease must loop with a target; with no target wait returns the first ready item immediately. Document or add 'wait --lease <holder|file>' to block until the file is free.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-Bff1731a132 --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed Bff1731a132 --regression-test <test>` first).
